results.s17_linf: If independent coordinate densities are <=K and s_17(A)>=s>0, then ||p_(X^TAX+b^TX+c)||_infinity < 3810 K^2/s. Same hypotheses as baseline; no new continuity claim.
results.graph_determinant: For Z=F(X_I)+2 X_I^T M X_J+G(X_J), |phi_Z(t)| <= det(I+t^2 M^T M/(2 pi^2 e))^(-1/8).
results.fractional_graph: If max row leverage <=q/2, q in [1,2], then |phi_Z(t)| <= det(I+q t^2 M^T M/(4 pi^2 e))^(-1/(4q)); order-four plus any fixed leverage gap gives L-infinity.
results.s13_l2: Applying this run to account04/B01's completed s13 L2 theorem yields ||p_Q||_2 < sqrt(3810) K/sqrt(s). This is not an s13 L-infinity theorem.

primary_source_premises: Rudelson--Vershynin arXiv:1402.4492 Theorem 1.2: independent one-dimensional densities <=K and l2-normalized coefficients imply scalar-sum density <=sqrt(2)K.
Banks--Garza Vargas--Kulkarni--Srivastava arXiv:2005.08930: bilinear-affine bounded-density theorem checked as prior art only; not used to replace same-bank phases.
Herry--Malicet--Poly smooth-iid Gaussian-field hypotheses do not match the arbitrary rough non-iid source class.

peer_results_applied.application: sharpened no-pivot graph constant and pivot bound to obtain ||p_Q||_2<sqrt(3810)K/sqrt(s)

structural_barrier: Exact account01/B08 and account02/B08 examples show both completion rank bounds rank(R)<=3r and rank(R[L,L])<=r are simultaneously sharp; unconditional s13 L-infinity now reduces to the order-four heavy-row leverage-near-one endpoint rather than a rank-retuning problem.
unresolved: Unconditional s13 L-infinity and lower multiplicities; first local endpoint is large order-four crossing volume with physical row leverage arbitrarily close to one. Full three-eigenvalue conjecture and full-target continuity remain open.
next_step: Build an original-coordinate physical-hub/curved-fiber receiver for the heavy-leverage row, or prove a product-preserving repartition that creates a leverage gap while retaining order-four crossing volume.
